methodology.climbDefinition: NOBO climb from the lowest calibrated elevation point after the previous listed mountain, capped at an 8-mile lookback.
methodology.difficultyDefinition: Movement-only 1-10 score weighted toward ascent, steep grade, Rockiness V2.1, then descent - the same formula used by the Hoggcountry map.
methodology.caution: Terrain planning screen only. Weather, wet rock, fatigue, pack weight, daylight, closures, and current trail conditions can make any mountain harder.
